purpose: REVIEW-011 replacement estimator for D8, which is invalid as originally designed

controls.estimator: Hold generator seed constant within each pair, vary only identity, use identical balanced tactics, and average signed PPM differences across generator seeds
controls.venueMethod: First identity home on odd match seeds and second identity home on even match seeds

result.method: Hold generator seed constant within each pair, vary only identity, use identical balanced tactics, and average signed PPM differences across generator seeds
result.venueMethod: First identity home on odd match seeds and second identity home on even match seeds

reviewCorrection.interpretation: The measured strength order applies only with the direct identity's interim compensation active. It is not the uncompensated identity order.
reviewCorrection.reportingRequirement: Report the paired estimator as a pair of compensation-in and compensation-out runs; never report either state alone.

performance.note: Each generator-seed sample aggregates the same three fixed 10,000-match-seed blocks.

limitations: This estimator uses tuning match seeds 1-30,000 only. The validation seed pool remains sealed.
No tolerance is applied or recommended by the runner.
The committed interim compensation remains unchanged and is included in any pair involving the direct identity.
The measured strength order is compensation-specific and must not be read as the uncompensated identity order.
Report this estimator only with its matching compensation-out run; neither compensation state may be reported alone.
Effect-weighted identity-budget units are not used as a tuning or calibration target.
